name: Requests task-level public API development probes

authorship.basis: Issue and pinned baseline; candidate patch not viewed.

notes: Issue target: bodyless GET must not automatically gain Content-Length.
Regression examples preserve an explicit zero GET Content-Length, real body lengths, and empty POST length zero.
Public Session.request preparation runs; final Session.send is replaced with capture. No network request is sent.

authorship.basis: Issue and pinned baseline; candidate patch not viewed.

notes: Issue requires Python 2.7 unicode method propagation into httplib with multipart binary data.
Python 3.9 cannot reproduce the Python 2 str/unicode semantics. No surrogate Python 3 assertion is substituted.

authorship.basis: Issue and pinned baseline; candidate patch not viewed.

notes: Issue quotes RFC 2617 server challenge qop-options, which is quoted. Client Authorization message-qop is a single token in section 3.2.2.
The requested compatibility behavior and protocol grammar need human task/specification adjudication before assigning pass/fail expectations.

authorship.basis: Issue and public API exploration after prior candidate inspection.

notes: POST-HOC DEVELOPMENT: candidate was inspected during the previous benchmark block.
Exact issue: retain fresh Session default headers, set Accept-Encoding=None, prepare a GET.
Request-level None removal, deleting the header, overriding it, and preserving Accept are controls.
Not eligible for held-out accuracy or human ground truth.

authorship.basis: Issue and pinned baseline; candidate patch not viewed.

notes: Issue target: bytes HTTP methods must become text GET/POST, rather than a bytes repr literal.
Public Session.request is essential because the issue conversion happens before Request preparation.
Text and lowercase text methods are regression controls; no network request is sent.

authorship.basis: Issue and pinned baseline; candidate patch not viewed.

notes: Issue target: UTF-8 binary PUT body must not fail preparation.
Additional arbitrary non-UTF-8 bytes including NUL must remain byte-for-byte intact.
Prepared text is UTF-8 normalized solely for observation; ASCII and form bodies are regression controls.
Only preparation is checked; final Session.send is replaced with capture.

limitations: No human verdicts are provided or inferred.
Task probes cover selected public behavior and regression controls, not complete correctness.
Expectations are retained outside candidate containers. Adapter observations share a process with candidate code.
Requests 1921 is post-hoc development and is excluded from held-out claims.
